title: KV-cache rehydrate emission gap during private KMS rotation + DR handback causing under-reported token usage
creator: Marco Hernandez
description: Customer escalation from a large Private deployment (Acme Health) after a scheduled KMS rotation and simultaneous DR handback resulted in under-reported token usage and a negative invoice adjustment. The customer reported a drop of ~22% in billed tokens for a 12-minute window followed immediately by large corrective credits and confusing invoice line items. This ticket tracks investigation, short-term mitigations, a code fix, and backfill reconciliation for affected ledgers.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) On a Private cluster, trigger a KMS rotation (simulate customer-managed KMS key rollover).

2) During the rotation window, trigger a DR handback (region B -> region A) to force routing and kv-cache rehydrate activity with a burst of synthetic traffic that includes retries and streaming clients,
3) Observe metrics emitter logs and the usage aggregator while forcing a controlled restart of the metrics-emitter service,
4) Compare per-request token accounting and ledger entries vs. generated token counts at the ingress proxy and the usage aggregator.
investigation: Initial forensic logs show the metrics-emitter thread that flushes per-session delta to the central ledger paused for ~7 minutes while the KMS rotation completed and a temporary lock held for the encryption key in the private control plane. Concurrently, kv-cache rehydrate from the warm node produced a short burst of replayed requests with identical session ids but missing 'emit_marker' metadata because the metrics emitter was offline. The aggregator deduplicator dropped these records (assumed replays), while upstream proxies incremented token counters — resulting in tokens being consumed by the model runtime but not recorded in the ledger. We also found a secondary issue: the rollup job treats zero-duration emit gaps as no-op and did not backfill partially flushed sessions when the emitter resumed. Correlated traces and a custom scatter plot on the usage dashboard show a clear gap aligning with the KMS rotation window and a spike in 'replay-suppressed' counts.
temporary_mitigation: 1) Re-enabled metrics-emitter in a non-blocking mode on affected private clusters so it buffers encrypted deltas to disk if KMS is temporarily unavailable (hotfix). 2) Ran ad-hoc reconciliation script to ledger-apply missing deltas in read-only mode for Acme Health; applied credits with accounting team sign-off. 3) Notified customers and billing ops with proposed timeline for full fix and backfill.
proposed_fix: Short term: change metrics-emitter to use a local envelope-based buffer that writes token deltas to an encrypted local queue when KMS is locked, with a small TTL to avoid permanent backlog. Medium term: add an explicit 'emit_marker' handshake between runtime and emitter so rehydrate bursts include an idempotency vector (runtime_session_id + emit_seq). Long term: update aggregator rollup to identify emitter-gap windows and run automatic backfill passes for sessions with unmatched runtime-ink tokens. Implement unit and e2e tests to simulate KMS-down and DR handback scenarios.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge hotfix PR to runtime-1.26 branch behind feature flag 'emitter-buffering'. 2) Canary deploy to 3 private clusters (non-production) with synthetic replay load for 24h. 3) Gradual rollout to 25% of private fleets over 48h while monitoring billing delta metrics and replay-suppressed counters. 4) After validation, enable on all Private clusters and include a follow-up run of backfill/reconciliation for customer windows. 5) Publish release notes and billing FAQ template for CS and Finance.
postmortem_followups:
- Automate detection: alert when emitter gap > 30s and replay-suppressed > threshold.
- Add playbook for billing reconciliation with pre-approved credit thresholds.
- Update private deployment runbook to coordinate KMS rotations with a grace window for metrics emissions.
- Add e2e test harness simulating KMS locks, DR handbacks and kv-cache rehydrates.
- Schedule audit of all Private clusters for similar gap patterns over past 90 days.
